csvImport.title: Імпорт {{name}}
csvImport.explanation: Виберіть Текст для поштових індексів, артикулів та IBAN; початкові нулі й числа, довші за 15 цифр, і так лишаються текстом у форматі «Загальний». Значення, що починаються з =, +, - або @, ніколи не зчитуються як формула (апостроф у попередньому перегляді).

names.title: Name manager
names.name: Name
names.reservedHint: This built-in name is managed by the workbook and cannot be changed here.
names.deleteHint: Formulas using this name may return an error afterwards. Undo restores the name.
names.editHint: The name stays the same; change its reference, visibility or scope.
names.definitionHint: Enter an absolute sheet reference, constant or formula. For example ='Sheet 1'!$A$1:$A$10, =0.21 or =SUM('Sheet 1'!$A$1:$A$10).
names.headersHint: Selected header rows or columns are excluded from the named data range. Spaces become underscores. Existing or duplicate names are never overwritten.

errors.invalidName: Use up to 255 characters without spaces or a cell address; start with a letter or underscore.
errors.emptyDefinition: Enter a range, constant or formula.
errors.duplicateName: Name “{{name}}” already exists in this scope.
errors.staleName: The name or workbook changed in the meantime. Refresh the list or create a new preview.
errors.invalidScope: The sheets changed in the meantime. Reopen this window.
errors.reservedName: Name “{{name}}” is reserved for the workbook.
errors.emptyHeaders: The selected headers contain no usable names.
errors.headerConflict: Header “{{name}}” produces a duplicate or existing name. Nothing was changed.
errors.selectionTooLarge: Select at most 5,000 header cells at a time.
errors.invalidSelection: Select headers with at least one adjacent data cell and choose the side containing the headers.
errors.readFailed: The name definitions or header cells could not be read.

numberFormat.localeHint: Controls default number/date display and input. Saved in this file.

errors.nameConflict: The workbook setting conflicts with an existing defined name.
errors.staleDocument: The workbook has changed. Reopen Format Cells.
errors.missingSheet: The original worksheet no longer exists.
errors.previewLoad: The number-format preview could not be loaded.
errors.approximate: The spreadsheet engine cannot display this format for this value. Choose or edit the format code.

numberFormat.engineNote: The preview shows the full formatted value. A narrow cell may shorten it or show overflow marks.
numberFormat.fractionHint: The denominator determines the fraction’s display precision.
numberFormat.unknownLocaleHint: This workbook has no supported locale setting. The existing setting is kept until you choose a locale.

conditional.title: Conditional formatting
conditional.priorityHint: Rules apply from top to bottom. Earlier rules have priority for each formatting property. Changes take effect when you choose OK.
conditional.invalidRange: Enter a valid cell range, such as A1:A10.
conditional.protected: Conditional formatting cannot be changed on this protected worksheet.
conditional.preserveStyle: The detailed source formatting is preserved. You can change the formula and range.

cycle.title: Circular reference
cycle.help: This formula depends on itself, directly or through other cells or sheets. Break the reference chain to calculate a result.

limited.title: Calculation limit reached
limited.help: The calculation could not finish within its limit. This cell may still show a saved result. Check the formula and its dependencies before using the value.

division.title: Division by zero
division.help: A division uses zero or an empty cell as its divisor. Check the divisor or handle this case with IF or IFERROR.

missing.title: Value not available
missing.help: The formula has no matching or available value. Check lookup values and ranges; NA() can also create this result deliberately.

name.title: Unknown name or function
name.help: Check the function spelling, named ranges and quoted text. A function that this engine does not support cannot be calculated.

intersection.title: Ranges do not intersect
intersection.help: The formula asks for an intersection of ranges that have no shared cells. Check range references and separators.

number.title: Invalid numeric result
number.help: A numeric argument is outside the functions domain or its result is outside the supported numeric range.

reference.title: Invalid cell reference
reference.help: The formula refers to a cell or sheet that no longer exists. Repair the reference or undo the deletion.

value.title: Invalid value or argument
value.help: An argument has an unsuitable value or type, such as text where a number is needed. Check the referenced cells and function arguments.

spill.title: Array result is blocked
spill.help: The array result cannot fill its destination cells. Clear blocking cells and check merged cells and the sheet boundary.

calculation.title: Calculation error
calculation.help: The formula could not produce a valid result. Check the expression, array dimensions and function support.

outline.title: Outline groups
outline.empty: This sheet has no outline groups.
outline.reloadHint: Changing an outline group reloads this workbook. The current undo history is cleared; cell contents and formatting are retained.
outline.invalidRange: Enter a valid row range (2:10) or column range (B:F). One row operation supports up to 10,000 rows.
outline.protected: Outline groups cannot be changed on a protected worksheet.
outline.readOnly: This workbook cannot be changed right now.
outline.overlapping: The file has overlapping column definitions. Resolve those before editing groups.
outline.tooDeep: A spreadsheet supports at most seven nested outline levels.
outline.summaryRequired: Keep a summary row or column beside the group to collapse it.

sheetProperties.reloadHint: This change reloads the workbook and clears its current undo history. Worksheet contents and objects are retained.
sheetProperties.keepVisible: A workbook must keep at least one visible sheet.
sheetProperties.noHidden: There are no hidden sheets available to unhide.
sheetProperties.veryHidden: This sheet is marked very hidden in the source file and cannot be unhidden here.
sheetProperties.structureLocked: The workbook structure is protected. Sheet visibility and tab colours cannot be changed.
